name: manual_c38204
claim: A blind find/replace private-IP-sanitization pass can silently break embedded example code inside documentation (fixture values replaced with themselves become no-ops, two roles collapsed onto one identical placeholder): after any automated sanitization pass over docs with code blocks, do a manual correctness re-read of those blocks — don't assume 'sanitized' means 'still illustrative and correct'.

decisions.notes: docs/wiki/2026-04-20-LM-Studio-autodiscovery-PLAN.md had 4 CodeRabbit findings, all from the same root cause: real IPs replaced with <YOUR_LAN_IP> everywhere, including places where two DISTINCT values (old/new fixture pair, mac/win roles, a real UDP-probe target) collapsed into one identical placeholder, making the example code contradictory or non-functional as written.

rationale: docs/wiki/2026-04-20-LM-Studio-autodiscovery-PLAN.md had 4 CodeRabbit findings, all from the same root cause: real IPs replaced with <YOUR_LAN_IP> everywhere, including places where two DISTINCT values (old/new fixture pair, mac/win roles, a real UDP-probe target) collapsed into one identical placeholder, making the example code contradictory or non-functional as written.
